title: aeon-trikaya: Fractal CREP Feedback and Trikaya State Classification (GenesisAeon Package 52)
description:
Fractal CREP feedback and Trikaya state classification for numeric-to-symbolic sensemaking. GenesisAeon Package 52.

A rule-based (not machine-learning) pipeline: numeric input is translated into symbolic form (tone frequencies, HSL colors, a glyph), scored with a discrete CREP heuristic, classified into one of three Trikaya states (PRÄSENZ / LEERE / AUFLÖSUNG), optionally refined through a fractal refeedback loop, and persisted with trend/volatility analytics over time.

See github.com/GenesisAeon/aeon-trikaya for source, documentation, and the honest epistemic-status breakdown of what's real vs. aspirational.
